about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_relief_golden.py, whose header describes relief-v1. Images are rows of R, G, B bytes; depth, normalized and dilated are rows of the map; eyeDepth is d at each pixel of the eye; holes are rows where 1 marks a filled pixel.

cases.name: production
cases.description: the settings of the app: 2 % of parallax, convergence in the middle

cases.name: strong
cases.description: a parallax of 25 % that opens holes beside the near object and at the left edge

cases.name: flat
cases.description: a constant map: d = 0.5 everywhere, the whole eye moved left, a hole column at the right edge

cases.name: dark
cases.description: a dark photo and a map with little relief
